run_sbatch_experiment_dry: run the sbatch experiment script in dry mode to preview the slurm command without submitting
run_sbatch_experiment_with_broker: run the sbatch experiment script with a custom broker address and number of peers
run_sbatch_experiment_custom_partition: run the sbatch experiment script targeting a specific slurm partition with a time limit
review_get_address: review the get_address function that resolves a broker address from SSH_CONNECTION or hostname
review_check_nfs: review the check_nfs function that verifies the current working directory is an NFS mount
